        "All owned hunks across both CSS files were read. The popup selector points --button-padding at --button-padding-wide. Default wide padding is 6px 14px and compact wide padding is 3px 9px; ordinary padding remains 6px/3px. The patch also defines button-min-height 32px/30px by density.",

A local .button rule consumes the ordinary padding token, but the imported popupnotification internals and complete cascade are not paired here. Defining min-height tokens is not proof every popup button consumes them, nor a measured width, clipping, touch-target or accessible-tree result.",
        "No changed tests/assertions. Logical margin/content-part rules stay separate from the padding token; this is scoped density/selector data, not a global mandate to widen every button.",
        "Complete original Root/B scopes are inherited; the two actual inline bodies were reconciled against source. The reviewer suggests a wide token with 6px 9px; the owned final source uses 6px 14px for default and 3px 9px for compact. Thus the token/density approach is adopted, not that exact default numeric proposal. The literal trailing-space cleanup is mechanical and does not establish a global styling rule. Referenced attachment and computed popup layout remain unread/unrun."
